The provided text explores the implicit theme of isolation versus connection through the symbolism of the lighthouse. The keeper’s solitude represents the human condition of being alone, while the lighthouse itself serves as a beacon of purpose and guidance. The visits from seafarers highlight the inherent human desire for connection, suggesting that even in isolation, individuals seek and provide meaning to others. The darkness surrounding the lighthouse symbolizes uncertainty or despair, which is dispelled by the light, reinforcing the idea that purpose is found in guiding and connecting with others.
